newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asiamatrix to buy engineering company.
newsitem.headline: Asiamatrix to buy engineering company.

text.p: Singapore electronics company Asiamatrix Ltd said on Friday it had entered into an agreement to buy 338,000 ordinary shares of Singapore $1 each in Mecplas Engineering Pte Ltd.
It said in a statement the purchase represented an 80 percent stake in Mecplas.
Mecplas is engaged in the design and manufacture of precision mechanical plastic components and moulds for a wide range of electronic products.

Asiamatrix said the purchase price was based on a formula comprising a first payment of S$1.2 million and a performance-linked deferred payment which would be dependent on the financial performance of Mecplas for the financial years ending December 31, 1997 and 1998.
The amount payable under the deferred payment scheme is subject to a maximum of S$936,00 and satisfied in cash, it said.
